cards.title: Moss Message Question Curl
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable notebook-margin revision card for adding one useful question beside a fictional moss message scene: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, fold the margin strip, and pick one moss message that still needs an answer: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write a question in the margin that makes the observatory scene clearer or more surprising: ____________________.
cards.marginPrompt: Margin prompt: What does the moss message make the watcher wonder next? ____________________.
cards.draftLinePrompt: Draft line: The moss message glowed on the observatory stone and said ____________________.
cards.revisionMovePrompt: Revision move: Add one question word, who, what, where, when, why, or how, to open a better story door: ____________________.
cards.newLinePrompt: New line: The watcher leaned closer and asked, ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Does the question point to a detail the next sentence can answer? ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Write only the question word and one moss clue: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use the same margin trick on another pretend message: ____________________.

cards.title: Tidepool Timekeepers Tiny Detail
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable notebook-margin revision card for adding one tiny lab detail to a fictional tidepool scene: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card and invite the writer to choose one pretend lab item, shell clock, bubble jar, or kelp ruler: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Place one small detail in the margin, then add it to the draft line: ____________________.
cards.marginPrompt: Margin prompt: Which tiny tidepool item shows the timekeepers are busy? ____________________.
cards.draftLinePrompt: Draft line: The tidepool timekeepers hurried across the table before the bell rang: ____________________.
cards.revisionMovePrompt: Revision move: Add one size, color, sound, or motion detail that readers can picture: ____________________.
cards.newLinePrompt: New line: The tidepool timekeepers hurried past ____________________ before the bell rang.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Does the new detail help the lab feel specific instead of plain? ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Circle one lab item and write only its best describing word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Add one more pretend lab detail in a notebook margin later: ____________________.

cards.title: Revision River Word Ferry
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable notebook-margin revision card for swapping one vague word in a fictional ferry sentence: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw a small margin ferry, and choose one flat word to send across the river: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write the old word on the ferry, then land it as a stronger word in the new line: ____________________.
cards.marginPrompt: Margin prompt: Which word feels too plain for the river ferry scene? ____________________.
cards.draftLinePrompt: Draft line: The ferry moved across the river with a big thing in its basket: ____________________.
cards.revisionMovePrompt: Revision move: Swap one plain word for a concrete word that names the object, action, or feeling: ____________________.
cards.newLinePrompt: New line: The ferry ____________________ across the river with ____________________ in its basket.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Did the swapped word make the scene easier to imagine? ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Write old word arrow new word in the margin: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Try one more word ferry swap on a different sentence: ____________________.

cards.title: Clue Label Tower Order Arrow
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable notebook-margin revision card for moving a fictional tower clue into a clearer order: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card and ask the writer to number three pretend label clues in the margin: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Put the clues in the order a museum helper would notice them, then rewrite the line: ____________________.
cards.marginPrompt: Margin prompt: Which clue should appear first, the label, the shelf, or the hidden tag? ____________________.
cards.draftLinePrompt: Draft line: The hidden tag, tall shelf, and blue label all gave the helper a clue: ____________________.
cards.revisionMovePrompt: Revision move: Move the clue that readers need first to the front of the sentence: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Does the new order make the tower mystery easier to follow? ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Write 1, 2, 3 beside the clues before changing the line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use margin numbers to sort three clues in another invented museum scene: ____________________.

cards.title: Compass Craft Setting Edge
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable notebook-margin revision card for adding a clearer fictional craft-academy place cue: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card and choose one academy corner, map table, ribbon shelf, tool bench, or compass mat: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Use the margin to name where the action happens, then fold that place cue into the sentence: ____________________.
cards.marginPrompt: Margin prompt: Where exactly in Compass Craft Academy does this moment happen? ____________________.
cards.draftLinePrompt: Draft line: The apprentice tested the compass before choosing the next path: ____________________.
cards.revisionMovePrompt: Revision move: Add one place cue and one nearby object so the setting has edges: ____________________.
cards.newLinePrompt: New line: Beside ____________________, the apprentice tested the compass before choosing ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Can a reader point to the place in the scene after your change? ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw a tiny place box and label the nearest object: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Add one place cue to another academy sentence on paper: ____________________.

cards.title: Binding Day Last-Line Knot
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable notebook-margin revision card for strengthening the last line of a fictional boardwalk booklet: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, fold the margin like a booklet flap, and choose one final object from the boardwalk table: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write the ending object in the margin, then use it to make the last line feel complete: ____________________.
cards.marginPrompt: Margin prompt: What final object can tie the Binding Day booklet together? ____________________.
cards.draftLinePrompt: Draft line: At the end of Binding Day, everyone looked at the finished booklet: ____________________.
cards.revisionMovePrompt: Revision move: Add one final object, action, or choice that shows what changed by the end: ____________________.
cards.newLinePrompt: New line: At the end of Binding Day, ____________________ showed that the booklet was ready.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Does the last line feel connected to the first important idea? ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Write the final object first, then build one ending sentence around it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Try a new last-line knot for another pretend booklet ending: ____________________.
